purpose.zh: 让上背转动更灵活，放松肩膀
purpose.en: Loosen up your upper back and relax your shoulders.

text.zh: 一只手掌心朝上，从另一只手臂下面穿过去
text.en: Slide one hand palm-up under your other arm

text.zh: 穿过去的肩膀往下沉，上背跟着转。
text.en: Let that shoulder sink as your upper back turns.

text.zh: 屁股留在膝盖正上方不动。
text.en: Keep your hips over your knees.

commonErrors.en: Shifting the hips to one side.
Twisting the lower back instead of the upper back.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时放松，只拉到舒服的程度
cautions.en: If anything hurts, ease off and stretch only to a comfortable point.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时停止，开始前先活动手腕
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness, and warm them up first.

changes: purpose 去掉「旋转」书面说法；cue3 去掉与口令重复的「慢慢回来」
顶点停 ~2 s → rep_hold，每侧分开做
